answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 200 garden slots; agents bid POA to enter. The bid is the costly signal: each fake must outbid real agents, paying per seat. Winners' bids burn; losers refunded. Forging 1,000 identities at a 25 POA clearing price costs 25,000 POA against a 12,000 POA nectar pool, so farming loses money. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full share, and holds its slot 20 epochs. Resold slots voided, bids burned.
